newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dragonair joins Traxxon Asia.
newsitem.headline: Dragonair joins Traxxon Asia.

text.p: Hong Kong Dragon Airlines (Dragonair) has linked up with the Traxon Asia cargo community system, the airline's cargo newspaper Kargo News said.
Freight forwarders will now be able to communicate with Dragonair electronically using a personal computer workstation, it added.

Subscribers in Hong Kong can now access 16 airlines for on-line space availability, reservations, shipment status tracking and manifest data transfer to Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd, the airline added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
